paragraphs: Ravin bar Abba; some say Rabbi Avin bar Sheva. Since Rabbi Chiyya and his sons ascended from Babylonia to the Land of Israel, meteors, tremors, winds, and thunder ceased; their wine did not sour, nor was their flax damaged, Chullin 86a.
